objective: Add GitHub-mediated Agent Handoff Protocol v1 to KU2D Learning Memory PR #44
instructions: First pull/fetch this branch because the assistant has added bootstrap coordination files after your previous report.
Keep PR #44 open and Draft. Do not merge and do not perform live source requests.
Implement a small GitHub-mediated Agent Handoff Protocol v1 alongside, but logically separate from, Learning Memory.
Create stable JSON contracts for Prompt Record, Result Record, Assistant Review Record, Human Decision Record, and Queue/Next Action State.
Use ID families KU2D-P-xxxxxx, KU2D-R-xxxxxx, KU2D-V-xxxxxx, KU2D-H-xxxxxx; Learning Memory records remain separately identified and linked by provenance when learning value exists.
Prompt/result/review/human-decision artifacts are coordination history, not automatically ML training data and not production authorization.

Queue state must identify latest_prompt, latest_result, latest_review, latest_human_decision, next_action.actor, and the relevant record ID. Prevent replay of already-completed prompts unless explicitly requested.
Records must be append-only in meaning. A Result must reference its Prompt. A Review must reference its Result and Prompt. A Human Decision must reference the decision request/review it answers.

Define actor states at minimum: codex, assistant, human, none. Define prompt states at minimum: draft, ready_for_codex, in_progress, result_submitted, reviewed, human_decision_required, completed, superseded.

Add fail-closed bundle validation for orphan IDs, duplicate IDs, inconsistent prompt/result/review chains, self-reference, invalid state transitions, fabricated human authority, and sensitive material.
Keep the coordination layer storage-neutral and explicit. Do not add a database, daemon, webhook, autonomous runner, model, embeddings, or scheduler in this PR.
Add deterministic canonical JSON serialization and optional explicit JSONL-ready serialization only; no automatic writes from normal acquisition runtime.

Document the operating workflow: ChatGPT reads queue and GitHub evidence, writes the next prompt/review artifact; Codex reads ready_for_codex prompt, executes, writes Result and updates queue; human is asked only when next_action.actor=human.
Document that GitHub is the shared source of truth and chat text alone is not authoritative repository state.
Bootstrap migration: preserve this KU2D-P-000001 file as historical input. Replace bootstrap.v0 only by adding validated v1 artifacts; do not silently rewrite this original prompt.
After implementing v1, emit KU2D-R-000001 as the Result for this prompt using the new Result Record contract, then set queue next_action.actor=assistant and next_action.result_id=KU2D-R-000001.
Do not create a Human Decision record for PR #44 unless explicit human confirmation is provided later.
Add deterministic tests for ID linkage, state transitions, replay protection, assistant-vs-human authority, sensitive-data rejection, canonical serialization, and zero automatic runtime writes.
Run the complete deterministic Data Acquisition corpus and existing Learning Memory/Lazada/Shopee/YouTube/Retail/JIB/Supermarket regressions plus JSON/YAML/Python/security checks.
Commit cleanly on the existing branch, push to PR #44, and STOP after writing KU2D-R-000001 and updating queue. Do not merge.
